Claire (CS): I drafted a tiny light-touch handbook for low-frequency accounts: a 60s checklist + a safe curl + fallback note. Shared for quick review.

Dev (SE): paste the curl here pls

Claire (CS): curl (safe):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-open-6b","prompt":"[warmup] prime","max_tokens":6}'
```

Raza (SRE): For light-touch: prefill TTL=900s, concurrency<=2. Emit metrics: lt.prefill.attempt, lt.prefill.success, lt.batch.flush, lt.stream.fallback. Alert if prefill.success=0 for 15m while attempts>0.

Marta (PM): Batching guidance: web = 80ms or 5 reqs; mobile = 150ms. Add prefer_latency for chat flows.

Claire (CS): Customer-facing fallback note (one para):

"Hi — were seeing intermittent streaming instability for your workspace. Weve temporarily routed your requests to a stable, non-streaming mode to keep responses reliable. No action needed; well update you within 1 hour. Reply if youd like a quick test command to run."

Dev (SE): sample sanitized logs for CSMs to request:
```log
[2026-08-01T11:02:10Z] tenant=lighttouch prefill=ok ttl=900 backend=g1
[2026-08-01T11:02:11Z] tenant=lighttouch batch=flush size=4 latency_ms=92 route=prefer_latency
[2026-08-01T11:05:00Z] tenant=lighttouch stream=fallback reason=kv_miss count=1
```

Claire (CS): thanks — Ill fold these into the one-pager and send to the CSM list after the staging tile is up. notify-bot: reminder for cs-sync later today.
